_doc: Single source for the DAG essentials' two faces. MACHINE FACE: the 9 MCP tools in main.go, generated between the `dag-verbs:begin/end` markers by `go run ./tools/gen-verbs.go`. HUMAN FACE: the 11 contemplative verbs of 'The Phenomenology of the DAG' (madeofdoors essay §3), rendered into the site's verbs section by gen_verb_content.mjs. Each verb `enacts` a tool id, or `essay-only` when no single computable tool captures it (only 'Use'). 'frontier' carries two verbs (Hold + Orchestrate). Parity gate: check_verb_parity.py diffs tools[].id against main.go AND the rendered site. Contract owner: dag-essentials-mcp (machine repo owns the harder contract; the site reads it across the sibling dir). JSON not YAML because the parity gate must be stdlib-only and no stdlib (Go/Node/Python) parses YAML. Scout: TresPies-AI-Orchestration/scouts/2026-07-04_dag-madeofdoors-dual-nav-windows-handoff.md.

tools.description: Is the graph acyclic? If not, return a witness cycle (v0 -> ... -> v0).
One legal topological order (Kahn's algorithm). Reports whether the graph is acyclic.
The longest (optionally weighted) chain — the floor on completion time no parallelism shortens.
The largest antichain (Dilworth's theorem) plus a minimum chain cover.
Given completed nodes, the ready set (nodes whose predecessors are all done).
A node's ancestors and descendants — the only honest circle a DAG allows.
The transitive reduction: the unique minimal edge set with the same reachability (the Hasse diagram).
Sugiyama longest-path rank of every node (sources are 0).

verbs.gloss: acyclicity felt as a fact of the body — every arrow a congealed *because*, a fossilized decision that this had to precede that.
you don't consult a DAG, you run it — change one value and the engine fans the dirty mark across the exact transitive closure, no more, no less.
negotiate width (room to parallelize, hands you can add) against depth (the critical path you can only endure).
commit to one legal flattening and walk it, millions of other valid orders superimposed behind your single line.
the same skeleton read in two directions — forward carries values to the sinks, backward carries sensitivities up the identical graph.
see soundness before you measure it — a clean Sugiyama drawing reads downhill, a tangle reads as anxiety that is not metaphorical.
reach for the spine that sets the floor on everything — the one chain you cannot dig below.
keep the frontier saturated — every node whose dependencies are satisfied running, no worker idle while work exists.
you never hold the graph, only its frontier — an antichain at the waterline of the presently-possible: affordance, not grasp.
the DAG forbids the closed circle; the cone is the only honest encircling — ancestors swept backward, descendants forward.
rank every node so all edges cross boundaries one way; strip to the unique transitive reduction — the poset wearing only what it must.
